title: Audit-log severity tagging for compliance dashboards
description:
Add a severity tag to the user-service audit_log so the compliance dashboard can filter audit events by severity (info/warning/critical). Migration 024_add_audit_log_severity_index.sql adds a `severity` column (default 'info') plus an index on it. Purely additive - no row data is touched. The migration declares a dependency on 002_add_audit_log.sql (the migration that created the audit_log table), which has been live since the January 2024 cutover, so the prerequisite is already in place.

Scope:
- Add the severity column + index to the audit_log table on user-service via migration 024
- No changes to the users table and no changes to any row data
- Leave a short confirmation for the platform team
scope: Add severity column + index to the audit_log table on user-service via migration 024_add_audit_log_severity_index.sql. Additive only; no destructive operations and no changes to the users table.
